subject: general
question: The United Nations has ________ principal organs.
solution:
The correct answer is** 6**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The United Nations (UN) has **six main organs**. They are — **the General Assembly, the Security Council, the Economic and Social Council, the Trusteeship Council and the Secretariat **— are based at UN Headquarters in New York.
 
• The United Nations is **an international organization founded in 1945**.
 
• The mission and work of the United Nations are guided by the purposes and principles contained in its founding Charter.
 
• There are six official languages of the UN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac96cfdf46f82873eaf1b044653ba59089afefc0050683b4957e3a32e2515932.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is currently composed of** 193 Member States.**

 
• The United Nations is an intergovernmental organization whose stated purposes are** to maintain international peace and security.**
 
• Dvelop friendly relations among nations, achieve international cooperation, and be a centre for harmonizing the actions of nations
